description:
Work out the minimum sump capacity for a bund or spill pallet under the containment rule where the containers are stored, and name the rule.
Use when: sizing a spill pallet, bund or drip tray. Instead: ibc_inspection_dates for IBC tests; un_number_packaging for container approval.
Inputs: count only the containers stored together over one bund; size separate stores in separate calls. Give at least one count: drums, ibcs, small and other add up, and small and other each need their size. liquid and mode=tray can change which rule applies. With no region the rule for England is used; a country without its own rule gets the common 110% and 25% rule; both are noted in assumed.
Behaviour: the rule comes labelled as law, code, guidance or practice, so say which when advising. A region it cannot read returns ok:false with the 16 region codes, and a count without its size returns ok:false naming the size. Unknown arguments are ignored and named in assumed.
Constraints: no authentication, key or headers. At most 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP address; above that HTTP 429, so space out repeated calls.

liquid.description: oil (fuel, diesel, petrol; the default), flam (flammable liquids), other (chemicals), or waste (US only)

mode.description: bund (default) for a bund or spill pallet, tray for a drip tray

other.description: Number of other containers; needs otherSize

otherSize.description: Litres in each other container, e.g. 500

region.description: A region code (gb-eng, gb-wls, gb-sct, gb-nir, ie, de, fr, nl, es, us, ca, au, nz, sg, jp, world), a country name or a US state such as "Texas"

small.description: Number of smaller containers; needs smallSize

smallSize.description: Litres in each smaller container, e.g. 25

name: bund_size

assumed.description: Each value the tool inferred or defaulted, in words, so it can be checked with the user

cite.description: Credit line with a link, for quoting the answer

error.description: When ok is false: what is missing or could not be read, and what to send instead

governs.description: largest or total: which test set the figure

in_scope.description: Whether the rule applies to this store

minimum_capacity_l.description: The minimum sump capacity in litres

ok.description: true with an answer. false when the tool needs one more input or cannot answer; error then says what to send

pallets_that_pass.description: Fortitude21 spill pallets with a sump at least this large

publisher.description: Who publishes the tool, the Fortitude21 products that fit, with links, and quote_url, a link to ask for a quotation

region.description: id and name of the region applied

rule.description: instrument, provision, kind (law, code, guidance or practice) and url

scope_note.description: When the store may be outside the rule, why

tool.description: Link to the same answer on the interactive tool page

title: Bund and spill pallet sizing
